author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you think you could lend me some of your records?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 gei2 zoeng1 CD bei2 ngo5 teng1 haa2 aa3？
text: 可唔可以借幾張 CD 俾我聽吓呀？

english.text: He has three sons, who became musicians.

jyutping: keoi5 jau5 saam1 go3 zai2，cyun4 bou6 dou1 zou6 zo2 jam1 ngok6 gaa1。
text: 佢有三個仔，全部都做咗音樂家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What am I to do next?

jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dim2 zou6 hou2 ne1？
text: 我而家點做好呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is often said that nothing is more precious than time.

jyutping: di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 mou4 mat1 je5 zung6 jiu3 dak1 gwo3 si4 gaan1。
text: 啲人成日話無乜嘢重要得過時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where are you going to go on your vacation?

jyutping: nei5 fong3 gaa3 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3？
text: 你放假諗住去邊度玩呀？

author: Riko

english.text: Did you like the meal?

jyutping: tau4 sin1 caan1 faan6 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 nei5 ge3 hau2 mei6？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Come on, get up.

jyutping: wai2，hei2 san1 laa3。

author: fercheung

english.text: He pretended not to hear me.

jyutping: keoi5 baan6 teng1 m4 dou3 ngo5 gong2 je5。

author: fercheung

english.text: All the people present were moved by his speech.

jyutping: zoi6 coeng4 ge3 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 bei2 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 gam2 dung6 zo2。

author: User55521

english.text: Why don't you just drop dead?
Why don't you go kill yourself?

jyutping: gam3 do1 jan4 sei2，m4 gin3 nei5 sei2？
text: 咁多人死，唔見你死？

english.text: Lenin ordered them to rebel.

jyutping: lit6 ning4 ming6 ling6 keoi5 dei6 faan2 kong3。

author: kaenif

english.text: He went to Rome, where he saw a lot of old buildings.

jyutping: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 lo4 maa5，gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 gau6 gin3 zuk1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I could hear the dog barking all night long.

jyutping: ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 teng1 dou2 zek3 gau2 hai2 dou3 fai6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The train arrived on time.

jyutping: gaa3 fo2 ce1 zeon2 si4 lai4 dou3。
text: 架火車準時嚟到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We're short on time.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 gau3 si4 gaan1 laa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Come home before six.

jyutping: luk6 dim2 zi1 cin4 hou2 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa3。
text: 六點之前好返屋企喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've always treated you with respect.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 nei5。
text: 我一直都好尊重你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The cookie jar is empty.

jyutping: go3 kuk1 kei4 zeon1 hai6 hung1 ge3。
text: 個曲奇樽係空嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't you think we're better off than we used to be?

jyutping: nei5 m4 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 sang1 wut6 bei2 ji5 cin4 hou2 zo2 me1？
text: 你唔覺得我哋而家嘅生活比以前好咗咩？

author: nickyeow

english.text: This is obviously impossible.

jyutping: hou2 ming4 hin2 m4 dak1 laa1。
text: 好明顯唔得啦。

english.text: Why don't you learn to speak Cantonese?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 m4 hok6 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2？

english.text: To investigate the incident would take us at least three weeks.

jyutping: tiu4 caa4 ne1 gin6 si6 gin6 zeoi3 siu2 jiu3 saam1 go3 lai5 baai3。

english.text: I've had enough to eat.

jyutping: ngo5 gau3 sik6。

english.text: If you like it, you can keep it!

jyutping: nei5 zung1 ji3 zau6 lo2 zo2 keoi5 laa1！

english.text: It is estimated that there are as many as 7,000 languages ​​in the world at the beginning of the twenty-first century, however most of them have not been documented in detail by the academic community.

jyutping: geoi3 gu2 gai3，jaa6 jat1 sai3 gei2 co1 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jau5 ciu1 gwo3 7,000 zung2 jyu5 jin4 gam3 do1，bat1 gwo3 daai6 bou6 fan6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 dou1 zung6 mei6 bei2 hok6 gaai3 coeng4 sai3 gam2 gei2 luk6 dai1。
text: 據估計，廿一世紀初嘅世界有超過 7,000 種語言咁多，不過大部份嘅語言都仲未畀學界詳細噉紀錄低。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: These days, at Starbucks café, I have been addicted to Oat Nog Latte, but this morning, I decided to have Iced Gingerbread Oat Chai. I sat in the back, near the restrooms. It is a grey-sky day. I walk practically everyday to get to the café. It was extremely windy, today, though. I stopped at Yummy Slice pizzeria for a Diet Coke and Subway sandwitcheria for a Turkey Ranch "Snackwich" just before the café. Heading home, I then visited Kin's Farm fruteria. Grandma Taiwan was there at the front: "Míng sà la!" she exclaimed. The lotus roots were out of stock. The wind was ferocious, as I walked back home. The neighbourhood Tim Hortons will be opening soon. Today is the 14th of December of 2024.

jyutping: ne1 gei2 jat6，hai2 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 ji5 ging1 soeng5 jan5 zo2 jin3 mak6 naa4 tit3，daan6 hai6 gam1 ziu1，ngo5 kyut3 ding6 sik6 bing1 goeng1 beng2 jin3 mak6 caa4。ngo5 zo6 hai2 hau6 min6，fu6 gan6 ge3 ci3 so2。gam1 jat6 hai6 fui1 tin1 ge3 jat6 zi2。ngo5 gei1 fu4 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 haang4 heoi3 gaa3 fe1 gun2。daan6 hai6，gam1 jat6 hou2 daai6 fung1。ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 cin4 min6 ting4 zo2 hai2 Yummy Slice bok6 beng2 pou2 jam2 faan2 bui1 gin6 ji4 ho2 lok6，tung4 maai4 hai2 dei6 tit3 saam1 man4 zi6 dim3 jam2 zo2 gaan1 fo2 gai1 muk6 coeng4「siu2 sik6」。faan1 uk1 kei2 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 zau6 heoi3 zo2 gam1 nung4 coeng4 ge3 gwo2 jan4 jyun4。toi4 waan1 po4 po2 hai2 zeoi3 cin4 min6：「Míng sà la!」keoi5 haam3 dou6。lin4 ngau5 mou5 fo3。fung1 hou2 daai6，ngo5 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2 ge3 si4 hau6。leon4 gan6 ge3 Tim Hortons hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 hoi1 zoeng1。gam1 jat6 hai6 2024 nin4 12 jyut6 14 hou6。
text: 呢幾日，喺星巴克咖啡館，我已經上癮咗燕麥拿鐵，但係今朝，我決定食冰薑餅燕麥茶。我坐喺後面，附近嘅廁所。今日係灰天嘅日子。我幾乎每日都會行去咖啡館。但係，今日好大風。我喺咖啡館前面停咗喺 Yummy Slice 薄餅舖飲返杯健怡可樂，同埋喺地鐵三文治店飲咗間火雞牧場「小食」。返屋企嘅時候，我就去咗金農場嘅果仁園。台灣婆婆喺最前面：「Míng sà la!」佢喊道。蓮藕冇貨。風好大，我行返屋企嘅時候。鄰近嘅 Tim Hortons 好快就會開張。今日係2024年12月14號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Now the ships were usually beached on the dry sand: / the young men were busy with weddings and their fresh fields: / I was deciding on laws and homesteads: suddenly, / from some infected region of the sky, came a wretched plague, / corrupting bodies, trees, and crops, and a season of death. / They relinquished sweet life, or dragged their sick limbs / around: then Sirius blazed over barren fields: / the grass withered, and the sickly harvest denied its fruits.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 di1 syun4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 hai2 gon1 saa1 soeng6 min6 ting4 bok6 hai2 dou6： / di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 mong4 jyu1 fan1 lai5 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 sin1 tin4 je5： / ngo5 kyut3 ding6 gan2 faat3 leot6 tung4 gaa1 jyun4：dat6 jin4 gaan1， / cung4 tin1 hung1 ge3 mau5 go3 sau6 gam2 jim5 ge3 dei6 keoi1，lai4 zo2 jat1 coeng4 ho2 lin4 ge3 wan1 jik6， / fu6 faa3 zo2 ge3 san1 tai2、syu6 muk6 tung4 nung4 zok3 mat6，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 sei2 mong4 ge3 gwai3 zit3 / keoi5 dei6 fong3 hei3 zo2 tim4 mat6 ge3 sang1 wut6，waak6 ze2 to1 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 beng6 taai3 ge3 sei3 zi1，hai2 tin4 je5 soeng6 min6 bei6 fau2 ding6 keoi5 ge3 gwo2 sat6。
text: 而家啲船通常都係喺乾沙上面停泊喺度： / 啲年輕人忙於婚禮同佢哋嘅新鮮田野： / 我決定緊法律同家園：突然間， / 從天空嘅某個受感染嘅地區，嚟咗一場可憐嘅瘟疫， / 腐化咗嘅身體、樹木同農作物，同埋一個死亡嘅季節 / 佢哋放棄咗甜蜜嘅生活，或者拖住佢哋病態嘅四肢，喺田野上面被否定佢嘅果實。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I know what it means to have a temper. You’ve seen what I'm like when I lose control. But even at my worst, I'd never willingly kill someone! And if I did, I know I'd feel some serious remorse for it. Even if I'd felt vindicated in the moment, once I calmed down, I'd regret my actions. I would never be so blasé or flippant about taking a human life, and neither should you!

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 cing1 co2 faat3 pei4 hei3 hai6 di1 mat1 je5 si6。nei5 gin3 gwo3 ngo5 sat1 hung3 go3 joeng2。daan6 zau6 syun3 hai2 ngo5 zeoi3 caa1 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 gu3 ji3 saat3 jan4！zau6 syun3 zan1 hai6 saat3 zo2，ngo5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 sam1 cit3 gam3 hau6 fui3。zik1 si2 go2 jat1 hak1 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 jau5 lei5、ceot1 hei3，daan6 laang5 zing6 lok6 lai4 zi1 hau6，ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 hang4 wai4 gam2 dou3 fui3 han6。ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 deoi3 dyut6 ceoi2 jat1 tiu4 jan4 meng6 gam3 heng1 fau4、gam3 mou5 so2 wai6，nei5 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 gam3！
text: 我好清楚發脾氣係啲乜嘢事。你見過我失控個樣。但就算喺我最差嘅時候，我都唔會故意殺人！就算真係殺咗，我知道自己一定會好深切咁後悔。即使嗰一刻覺得自己有理、出氣，但冷靜落嚟之後，我一定會為自己嘅行為感到悔恨。我絕對唔會對奪取一條人命咁輕浮、咁冇所謂，你都唔應該咁！
